public.text: Exposing legacy data through standard APIs may not be technically feasible and can create a façade that does not resolve inconsistent semantics or poor data quality.
public.suggestedRevision: Allow alternatives such as read-only extraction, scheduled bulk exchange, event capture, external adapters, data replication, document exchange, or staged migration. Require semantic mapping and quality assessment.
